title: BillBox
oneLiner: A household receipt shelf: capture a bill once, find it by merchant, tag, amount or date.
claim: Only the API writes. The browser reads rows the household owns and every write is checked against membership.

metrics: Sections 1 to 6 implemented: auth and households, capture, extraction, tagging, search, export, offline queue
Backend tests and the frontend typecheck and build pass; a Playwright suite covers all six section checkpoints in CI
The API is the only writer - browsers get the anon key and can select rows the household owns
15 seeded system bill-type tags and RLS-enforced storage

media.alt: The BillBox app showing a captured electricity bill with its extracted fields
media.caption: Capture once. The fields come out already readable.

media.alt: The BillBox app showing a captured water bill alongside the household receipt list
media.caption: The shelf, searchable by merchant, tag, amount or date.

proof.architecture: A React PWA talks to a FastAPI service on Cloud Run. Supabase holds Postgres, private storage and auth. Extraction is mocked in tests and handled by Gemini in production, with rule-based tagging in front of it. Offline captures queue locally and drain when the connection returns.
